hypotheses.name: Biologically weighted directed/signed failure-slice rescue
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}, computed weighted directed/signed topology scores using support-aware edge weights (DoRothEA+OmniPath+STRING+GO) and compared against unweighted directed/signed and distance-only baselines with biological-weight shuffle, random-strata placebo, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean weighted-vs-unweighted delta AUROC=-0.00052; weighted-vs-distance mean delta=+0.01137; failure slices remained negative (lung/source=-0.00193, external_lung/source=-0.00433)
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this weighting-tweak formulation and pivot to a materially changed topology method (e.g., support-margin multiparameter filtration) if continuing the branch.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Second-stage weighting tweak failed to rescue source-disjoint failures and slightly regressed vs unweighted directed/signed.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model topology-signature transfer pilot
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with held-out-domain transfer over source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; built per-gene topology signatures in scGPT and Geneformer, learned Procrustes maps on source domains, and evaluated target edge AUROC from mapped Geneformer-to-scGPT compatibility with random-map and signature-destroy permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean transfer delta AUROC=+0.02404 with positive rows 10/12, but null-robust support failed (rows p_best<0.05: 0/12; domain Fisher-significant: 0/3)
hypotheses.next_action: Do not expand this pilot until a stronger transfer objective or stricter null calibration is introduced.

hypotheses.name: Endpoint intrinsic-dimension jump broad screen
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11}, estimated local ID with TWO-NN and local MLE, built edge ID-jump features, and compared combined ID-jump score against geodesic baseline with endpoint-swap, estimator-randomization, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.00435; positive rows 31/72; positive mean domain-splits 3/6; Fisher-significant domain-splits 1/6 (immune/source, negative direction)
hypotheses.next_action: Retire standalone endpoint ID-jump formulation and deprioritize ID-family endpoint screens unless objective is materially changed.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Repeated intrinsic-dimension endpoint formulations are now net negative under multiseed controls.
